'''2001 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Wisconsin in 2001.<ref name="dt-16241">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16241 Kreml (stronghold)], DeckTech (Matt "Ooryl_909" Woleske, 27 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16241/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16241/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 27 May)
* '''Site:''' Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

| 2–1 || Matt Woleske<ref name="dt-16241" /> || — || [[2001 Wisconsin State Championship Matt Woleske Kreml (stronghold)|Throne Room Mains]]
|}

Woleske went 2–1 with his Light Throne Room mains deck; his only loss was to Christian Kriesel's Hunt Down deck. He notes the version he played at the event used Insurrection and Staging Areas where the posted list has Twi'lek Advisors.<ref name="dt-16241" />
